title: Steps to Add Assets or Liabilities

steps.text: Select the appropriate option. Click on “Add Assets” or “Add Liabilities,” depending on the current screen option.
Enter asset or liability details. For example, when adding an asset, choose the product type, currency, and provide a name.
Confirmation screen. A success message will appear confirming that the new asset or liability has been added.
View updates. Returning to the dashboard, the customer will see the newly added assets reflected in their total assets and overall net worth.
